capability: Reconstruct per-ply clock differences from a bounded annotated PGN mainline without hiding missing evidence.
user: Chess study authors auditing recorded clock annotations in a short standard-start game.
pain: Missing annotations or an unexplained clock increase should not silently become zero thinking time.
expected: Exit 0 with elapsed milliseconds [3000,2000,3000,5000]; known totals are white 6000 and black 7000 under the stated increment convention.
contract: One UTF-8 PGN, mandatory simple integer TimeControl base+increment, standard initial position and alternating SAN-like mainline labels. Brace [%clk H:MM:SS[.fff]] annotations are exact milliseconds. Assumption: each annotation is after its move and that move’s increment, including the first captured move. elapsed = previous same-side clock + increment - current clock. Missing evidence invalidates the next same-side difference until a new baseline is captured. An increase exceeding increment is a finding with no elapsed value. Balanced variations, semicolon comments and NAGs do not contribute clock evidence; header/body result agreement is enforced.
limits: 128 KiB, 64 headers, 10,000 plies, variation depth 32, token length 64; base 1–86400 seconds and increment 0–3600. No multi-stage/delay controls, FEN starts, variants, multiple games or sub-millisecond clocks. Move labels are not checked for chess legality. No engine, cheating, flag, network lag or actual-thinking-time inference; totals cover only computed evidence.
acceptance: Reproduce increment arithmetic, fractional milliseconds, per-side missing-clock resynchronization, ignored variations, and reject duplicate/leading clocks, malformed controls, wrong move numbers and result conflicts.
notes: python-chess already supports PGN clock and elapsed annotations and legal move handling. Chesslib offers a broader Java chess model; mliebelt/pgn-parser produces a structured PGN representation. Their broader capabilities are not replaced. Our dependency-free evidence ledger has stricter bounded input and deliberately does not validate legal chess.
alternatives: Use python-chess clock accessors, Chesslib or pgn-parser and implement the desired accounting convention.
overlap: No existing owned chess/PGN project was found. Other timing tools handle different input domains and do not parse chess mainlines and per-side clock evidence.
